metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Len Sparebulb
records.biography_en: Len Sparebulb joins Deep Sea After Hours as lanternfish maintenance worker. “I brought a spare.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small warm luminous bulb on short forehead stalk and one smooth spare bulb in hand.

records.name: Nora Clamledger
records.biography_en: Nora Clamledger joins Deep Sea After Hours as clam shift supervisor. “Who clocked out in my shell?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small rounded clam shell collar and a thick clipboard.

records.name: Bram Ventcheck
records.biography_en: Bram Ventcheck joins Deep Sea After Hours as tube worm vent regulator. “The vent runs a little hot.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small pale rolled tube at flank and a short chunky thermometer with red tip.

records.name: Faye Softsignal
records.biography_en: Faye Softsignal joins Deep Sea After Hours as bioluminescent signal keeper. “One blink means I'm still here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short bead antennae and one sealed cyan lantern.

records.name: Gus Siltsettle
records.biography_en: Gus Siltsettle joins Deep Sea After Hours as sediment cleaner. “It settles after my shift.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny smooth silt scoop with a small pale mound and broad short brush.

records.name: Pip Pressurecup
records.biography_en: Pip Pressurecup joins Deep Sea After Hours as break-time resident. “The coffee is under pressure.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: compact thick-walled deep-sea mug with handle.
